purpose: Migrate Chemistry governance to the definitive SymC General Operations Manual v0.8.0 without changing frozen scientific settings, thresholds, active calculations, historical failures, or Atlas contents.

gom_v0_8_0_localization_rule.principle: The GOM retains program-wide transferable safeguards while project-specific equations, datasets, Atlas targets, implementation details, and chemistry-specific scientific firewalls remain in Chemistry project governance.
chemistry_project_controls_that_must_rem: generator-first dynamical interpretation and finite-precision exceptional-point rigor
barrier-top unstable frequency omega_b is not the restoring omega_0 used for canonical mechanical chi
stable-well chi or critical damping does not by itself establish barrier crossing, first-passage commitment, reaction rate, yield, or selectivity
distinct estimator routes may be treated as the same physical damping/friction quantity only after a justified equivalence or calibration test
memory or Markov reductions use the native local dynamical timescale relevant to the reduction rather than an unrelated overall waiting time
literature pairing preserves system, phase, temperature, medium, units, conventions, evidence tier, and extraction provenance
source, calibration, model, and outcome independence are tracked on the pathway relevant to the claim
post-result representative selection remains discovery/diagnostic evidence and carries promotion debt
Barrier Atlas and Engine remain independent evidence paths; the Engine may not retune the Atlas to improve agreement
R1 release reproducibility, R2 calculation reproducibility, and R3 evidence reconstruction are reported separately
historical scientific HOLDs, discrepancies, refusals, and dead ends remain preserved
Function Map and Limit Map are developed together where native chemistry supports them
local dynamical identity is kept separate from embedded realized behavior and system-level stability

active_run_isolation.rule: Do not modify the active personal-free-compute branch solely to adopt GOM v0.8.0 while the frozen L21 contingency execution is in progress.
active_run_isolation.reason: The governance migration is not needed to complete the already-frozen calculation and must not perturb or supersede its execution identity.

required_checks: active L21 execution reaches a valid terminal state or is explicitly dispositioned
no scientific setting or threshold changed by this governance migration
project-local chemistry controls remain at least as strict as the controls they replace from the older GP/domain-addendum structure
current computational and Atlas states are synchronized in the project control record
stale or superseded workflow executions are cancelled or deterministically refused before expensive work
post_run_adoption_gate.adoption_consequence: After these mechanical/governance checks pass, this mapping may replace the older local GP adoption pointers without changing any scientific result.
